name: Heures réalisées par société et par semaine
query:
-- Heures réalisées par société et par semaine
SELECT 
    COALESCE(o.firm_description, 'Non affecté (externe/visiteur)') AS societe,
    strftime('%Y', t.result_date) AS annee,
    strftime('%W', t.result_date) AS semaine,
    SUM(t.hours) AS heures_theoriques_planifiees_selon_contrat,
    SUM(t.physical_hours) AS heures_physiques_reellement_travaillees,
    SUM(t.days) AS somme_jours_travail_ensemble_salaries,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.employee_key) AS nombre_salaries
FROM kelio_resultat_total t
LEFT JOIN kelio_organigramme o ON t.section_key = o.section_key
WHERE t.account_type = 'ACCOUNT'
    AND t.result_date >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY societe, annee, semaine
ORDER BY (o.firm_description IS NULL), societe, annee DESC, semaine DESC;

name: Absences par type par société et par semaine
query:
-- Absences par type par société et par semaine
SELECT 
    COALESCE(o.firm_description, 'Non affecté (externe/visiteur)') AS societe,
    a.type_abbreviation AS type_absence_abreviation,
    a.type_description AS type_absence_description,
    strftime('%Y', a.start_date) AS annee,
    strftime('%W', a.start_date) AS semaine,
    SUM(a.total_in_days) AS total_jours_absence,
    SUM(a.total_in_hours) AS total_heures_absence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.employee_key) AS nombre_salaries_concernes
FROM kelio_absence_fiche a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT employee_key, section_key
    FROM kelio_resultat_total
    WHERE section_key IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY employee_key
) emp ON a.employee_key = emp.employee_key
LEFT JOIN kelio_organigramme o ON emp.section_key = o.section_key
WHERE a.start_date >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY societe, a.type_abbreviation, a.type_description, annee, semaine
ORDER BY (o.firm_description IS NULL), societe, annee DESC, semaine DESC, type_absence_abreviation;
